attempts.summary: Configured VLAN segmentation over the shared eth1 link: node2 tags traffic 802.1Q VLAN 10 (10.10.10.11/24 on eth1.10), node3 tags VLAN 20 (10.10.20.12/24 on eth1.20), and node1 (VyOS) routes between them via eth1.10 (10.10.10.254/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.254/24) sub-interfaces with IP forwarding enabled. Static routes on node2/node3 direct inter-VLAN traffic through node1 while preserving each host's existing default route via eth0. Verified end-to-end reachability (ttl=63 confirms routing through node1) and VLAN isolation (untagged eth1 path fails). All configuration was persisted (VyOS `save`, NetworkManager connection profiles) and each node was individually restarted with boot-id proof of restart, followed by full re-verification of VLAN interfaces, routes, and cross-VLAN ping connectivity.
